tools.name: book_usergems_demo
tools.description: Open the UserGems contact page to book a demo or talk to sales. Use when the user wants to see UserGems in action, get a quote, or evaluate UserGems for their team.

tools.name: compare_usergems_to_competitor
tools.description: Open a side-by-side comparison between UserGems and a named competitor. Use when the user asks 'UserGems vs X', how UserGems compares to an alternative, or is evaluating similar tools.

competitor.description: Competitor identifier. Must be one of the listed values.

tools.name: get_company_overview
tools.description: Get a summary of what UserGems does without leaving the current page. Use when the user asks what UserGems is or what problem it solves.

tools.name: view_blog_and_guides
tools.description: Open UserGems' blog with playbooks and guides on signal-based selling. Use when the user wants educational content, best practices, or research.

tools.name: view_customer_stories
tools.description: Open UserGems' customer stories page. Use when the user asks for case studies, customer results, social proof, or who uses UserGems.

tools.name: view_pricing
tools.description: Open UserGems' pricing page. Use when the user asks how much UserGems costs or what plans are available.

tools.name: view_product_feature
tools.description: Open a UserGems product page for a specific capability. Use when the user asks about a specific feature like job-change tracking, buying signals, buying groups, AI emails, or the UserGems API and MCP server.

feature.description: Product capability. Must be one of the listed values.

tools.name: view_solution_by_team
tools.description: Open the UserGems solution page for a specific go-to-market team or motion. Use when the user identifies as a sales, marketing, RevOps, or customer success leader, or asks how UserGems fits ABM.

team.description: Team or GTM motion. Must be one of the listed values.
